$$z^3 (1 - x^2y^2) = - (x^3 + y^3)$$

$$x^3 + y^3 \ge y^3 (x^2y^2 - 1)$$
$$x^3 + y^3 \ge x^2y^5 - y^3$$

We proceed by contradiction. Assume that $x^2y^2 > 3$. Since $x \le y$, we analyze this under two cases based on the value of $x$.

We check the inequality $(**)$: $x^3 + 2y^3 \ge x^2y^5$.
